name: Bitcoin value overflow incident
technique: Integer overflow in output value check
rootCause: Block 74638 contained a transaction creating 184,467,440,737 BTC. The output-sum check overflowed a 64-bit integer, so the client accepted it as valid. A patched client (0.3.10) and a soft fork orphaned the chain within ~5 hours. (CVE-2010-5139)
